_help: Manual fixes. Key = theater id from public/theaters.json. Fields: any theater field to replace (name, brand, website, address, imax, showtimes_key), hidden: true to hide, show: true to show a candidate or a record marked closed, match: {osm, overture} to force-pair records, add: true (with name, lat, lon) to add a theater by hand. Keys starting with _ are ignored; _note is free text.
